correctness.rationale: For n>=4 and m=2n, G=C_m squared has degree 4. Every size-4 set that can force at time 0 equals a center and three of its four neighbors; deletion reduces to exactly 3m distinct A_i,B_i,C_i families. Synchronous blue-interval induction gives propagation n-2 for A and n-1 for B,C, including final one-point front collision. For token jumping, set intersection size 3 gives the explicit neighbor table; degrees 8 for A, 5 for B/C, and 9m=18n edges. Center-coordinate map changes by cyclic distance <=1 on every edge, proving each eccentricity >=n; path via consecutive triples of A anchors gives <=n. Independently brute-enumerated minimum-size forcing configurations, graph edges and all-pairs eccentricities for n=4..8, not a substitute for the uniform proof.
